items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of bonfire permit
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Behörde: Amt Musterschlei, Am Markt 6, 24376 Musterkappeln.
items.computation: Letter is dated 18.11.2026 (Wednesday); no separate mailing date is given, so it is assumed the 'Aufgabe zur Post' (posting) also occurred on 18.11.2026. The letter states its own delivery-fiction rule (§ 110 Abs. 2 LVwG): 'gilt am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben.' Counting 4 days after 18.11.2026: 19.11 (day 1, Thu), 20.11 (day 2, Fri), 21.11 (day 3, Sat), 22.11 (day 4, Sun). Since no mail is delivered on a Sunday, the fictitious notice (Bekanntgabe) shifts to the next working day, Monday 23.11.2026 (standard rule analogous to § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG, also applied under LVwG). Bekanntgabe = 23.11.2026. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist runs under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB (the Bekanntgabe day itself is not counted) and ends per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB with expiry of the day of the following month bearing the same number as the Bekanntgabe day: 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in Schleswig-Holstein, so no further shift under § 193 BGB is needed. The Widerspruch must reach the authority (in writing or recorded orally at the office) by this date.

warnings: The exact posting date (Aufgabe zur Post) of the letter is not stated; it was assumed to equal the printed document date (18.11.2026). If the letter was actually posted on a later date, the Widerspruch deadline shifts accordingly.

The letter cites a four-day delivery fiction ('gilt am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben', § 110 Abs. 2 LVwG) rather than the three-day rule typically found in comparable federal provisions (§ 41 VwVfG, § 122 AO); double-check this matches the current wording of the Schleswig-Holstein Landesverwaltungsgesetz before relying on the computed date.
